note: The enumerated security-critical set for mutation testing (mutmut / cosmic-ray) and coverage-guided fuzzing (cargo-fuzz + atheris). THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: the mutmut config (pyproject.toml [tool.mutmut]) and the cosmic-ray config (tools/mutation/cosmic-ray.toml) must mutate exactly the python files marked mutation=true here, and integration/tests/test_mutation_critical_set.py fails the build if any listed file is missing or the configs drift from this list. Categories: gate (WARDEN authorization AND the K4 customer billing/launch/settle authorization chokepoints), oracle (defensive detection/confirmation), verifier (tamper-evidence), signing (cryptographic authenticity, incl. the K4 completion-signal + per-slug delegation), parser (attacker-controlled-input decoders — the fuzz targets). The K4 money/settle guards that live on the SOVEREIGN leg (apps/sigil/*, assert_no_offense) are mutation=false: the scheduled python kill-suite is deliberately scoped to the vigil_core + sensitivity/fuzz meta-tests to stay tractable and cannot load framework alongside the sovereign-purity asserts, so those files are covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual + their named suites instead (the same reason models.py and the rust files are mutation=false).

critical_set.reason: The WARDEN tool->tier classifier + gate decision (sovereign port of tiers.rs). Lowering a dangerous tool below A3, or reaching A0 without a positive allowlist, is a fail-open.
The offense-side WARDEN gate: classifies + fail-closes every tool invocation before it can run.
The AEGIS gateway inline request/response inspector: parses the HTTP attack surface and runs the request-side oracles. A weakened check is a missed block; a broadened one is a false block.
confirm_finding: turns a lead into a CONFIRMED verdict only with a re-runnable certificate (prove-don't-guess). A mutation that confirms without proof manufactures evidence.
OracleVerifier: the deterministic re-execution authority behind every confirmation.
The tamper-evident hash-linked spine verifier (verify_chain / verify_head / anti-rollback). A mutation that verifies a tampered chain destroys audit integrity.
Deterministic canonical-JSON bytes + digest every signature is computed over. Non-determinism here silently breaks tamper-evidence.
Ed25519 sign / verify_one / verify_threshold: the cryptographic authenticity substrate. A verify that fails open is catastrophic.
pydantic spine-record models (ChainEntry / SignedChainHead). Data definitions with little branch logic; the record PARSER is exercised by the spine fuzz harness rather than mutation.

K4 completion->settle authenticity: sign_engagement_completion / verify_engagement_completion (Ed25519 threshold, fail-closed, tamper-reject). A verify that fails open lets a FORGED worker completion trigger a sovereign settle (a free or over-charged run). Mutmut/cosmic-ray cover it via the scheduled kill-suite (packages/core/vigil_core/tests/test_engagement_completion.py).

K4 production-execution HOLD: customer_prod_execution_enabled() is the fail-closed, default-OFF flag that keeps customer production-target execution disabled until the K4-6 acceptance matrix passes. A mutation flipping the default or inverting the truthy check lifts the hold silently. Covered by the scheduled kill-suite (packages/core/vigil_core/tests/test_posture.py).

PRICING M1 model grant: the owner-signed per-run bearer token a customer run presents to the sovereign model gateway (domain-tagged Ed25519, canonical body and canonical base64url, strict schema, the per-launch meter id). A decode that fails open lets a forged grant spend VIGIL's provider key; a meter id that collides lands one launch's spend on another. Covered by packages/core/vigil_core/tests/test_model_grant.py.

PRICING M1 metering arithmetic: the price table, usage parsing (incl. the refusal of usage that reports unpriced spend), exact integer cost, the markup / floor / reservation clamp and the USD cap a reservation buys. A mutation that prices a token low, floors instead of ceils, drops the clamp or accepts unpriced usage mis-bills every metered run. Covered by packages/core/vigil_core/tests/test_model_metering.py.

PRICING M1 sovereign model gateway: holds the one provider key, authenticates grants, allowlists and pins every request, reserves each request's worst case against the run's cap, and keeps the write-ahead hash-chained per-launch meter the settle charges from. Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense), so it is NOT on the vigil_core-scoped scheduled kill-suite; covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual (the mutant list is in the M1 PR) + apps/sigil/tests/test_model_gateway.py.

Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense), so it is NOT on the vigil_core-scoped scheduled kill-suite; covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_k45_loopback_e2e.py (same rationale models.py/rust are mutation=false).

PP-1 enterprise postpaid: the owner-signed account-mode LWW registry (set_account owner-signed+FRESH; disable safe-direction on-sight/webhook-fresh; per-org high-water blocks replay-resurrection of a disabled line) + the ADDITIVE per-org arrears ledger (accrue/reverse idempotent per entry_id; accrued = debits-reversals clamped >=0; forged debit/credit inert) the launch gate draws against INSTEAD of prepaid credits (admit up to the owner-signed credit_limit, accrue, over-limit refuse; settle reverses the unconsumed draw, detected via the owner-signed debit record so it never mis-refunds to the prepaid wallet). v8 snapshot seed (postpaid_state/issued/row + postpaid_arrears_debited/credited/seen) + prune tripwires (spine/prune.py stranded_active_postpaid + stranded_postpaid_arrears). A weakened verify/high-water/clamp/limit guard lets a tenant draw past their line or a forged record move arrears. Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense); per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_postpaid.py + test_snapshot_fold_postpaid.py + test_postpaid_gate.py. PP-2 adds invoice_postpaid_arrears (bills the un-invoiced drawn DELTA each period from the owner catalog, idempotent per (org, period); reuses the invoice + arrears ledgers, no new spine record; payment->reversal deferred to PP-2b/prod-gated); covered by test_postpaid_invoicing.py (5/5 guards mutation-verified: delta no-double-bill, nothing-new guard, is_postpaid gate, postpaid-kind filter, catalog amount). PP-2 red-pen fold: the invoicing basis is net_settled_consumed = accrued - in_flight_reserved (an IN-FLIGHT reserve -- a RESERVE_ENTRY_PREFIX debit whose SETTLE_ENTRY_PREFIX settle record has not landed -- is held OUT of billing, so a reserved-but-unconsumed or later-cancelled launch is never over-billed; the gate+ledger share the reserve/settle entry-id prefixes so pairing cannot drift). A SECOND red-pen on the fold found + closed 3 confirmed money bugs: (HIGH) a full-consumption launch (refund==0) was billed $0 because the gate wrote the settle credit only `if refund > 0` -- fixed by PostpaidArrearsLedger.settle(refund>=0) which ALWAYS records the settle marker (even 0, a balance no-op that clears the reserve from the in-flight set), called unconditionally by launch_gate.settle_launch; (HIGH) a wall-clock/month period key dropped a same-month re-run's new delta (leak on close-before-rollover) -- fixed by content-addressing invoice_id on the per-org billing high-water invoiced_before (deterministic across processes: concurrent racers collide+dedup, sequential new deltas advance; period_end is now only a label); (MED) a hard prune of an in-flight reserve hid it from in_flight_reserved's live scan -> over-bill -- closed by the spine/prune.py stranded_active_postpaid_reserves tripwire (fail-closed: refuses any prune that would archive a reserve whose settle has not landed). 6 fold guards mutation-verified total (in-flight subtraction, settle-pairing exclusion, gate unconditional settle-marker, content-addressed invoice id, prune in-flight tripwire + its wiring); covered by test_postpaid_invoicing.py + test_postpaid_gate.py (full-consumption) + test_snapshot_fold_postpaid.py (tripwire). PP-2b adds invoice PAYMENT -> OUTSTANDING-balance tracking: a payment is a kind=payment receipt in the invoice ledger (price_id postpaid_payment), DISTINCT from the arrears ledger so it never lowers accrued / net_settled_consumed / invoiced_postpaid_total (the billing basis) -- it only moves postpaid_outstanding = invoiced - paid (clamped >=0, the scalar PP-3 dunning will test). pay_postpaid_invoice settles ONE named owner-signed postpaid invoice in full (amount from the invoice, never a wire value), idempotent per pay:{invoice_id} (first-mint-wins), org-scoped (fail-closed on unknown/non-postpaid/cross-tenant/empty). 3 guards mutation-verified (outstanding = invoiced-paid, pay idempotency, pay postpaid-kind filter); covered by test_postpaid_payment.py. invoices.py gains the payment kind (no new signal/snapshot; stranded_invoices covers it). PP-3 adds DUNNING -> credit-gate: postpaid_overdue_amount/postpaid_is_overdue flag a tenant with any UNPAID postpaid invoice past its net-terms due date (period_end + net_terms_days; PAID = a pay:{id} receipt exists), fail-closed (not overdue) on empty id / unknown account / non-finite clock; the launch gate (ui/launch_gate.py, now holding an InvoiceRegistry) adds an OVERDUE conjunct that refuses NEW reserves (the SAFE access-reducing direction, reversible on payment; an in-flight launch still settles), DISTINCT from the PP-1 credit-line cap. 3 guards mutation-verified (the gate dunning conjunct, the paid-exclusion, the due-date comparison); covered by test_postpaid_dunning.py + test_postpaid_gate.py (overdue-refuses-until-paid + prepaid-never-dunned).

EC-4 per-tenant token-cost envelope ledger: owner-signed reserve/settle (both directions verify_signed under the key-valid-at-seq; a forged/unsigned record of either kind is inert in the fold -- NO honored-unsigned direction, like the wallet). ADDITIVE + idempotent per (signal, org_id, entry_id) (a replay -- incl. one re-appended after a hard prune -- counts once); settle CLAMPS the actual tokens to the owner-signed reserved envelope (a forged over-report can never charge/draw past the reservation); tokens clamped >=0 (a forged NEGATIVE record cannot refund cost / draw the pool back). in_flight = sum of reserved-but-unsettled (the pending pool draw, held OUT of committed cost; a LIVE {slug}:{nonce}-suffix pairing scan mirroring postpaid in_flight_reserved); committed = sum of settled ACTUAL. v9 snapshot seed (cost_reserved/cost_settled/cost_seen) + prune tripwires (spine/prune.py stranded_cost_ledger for the per-org aggregate + stranded_active_cost_reserves for an in-flight reserve below the prune boundary) so a hard prune can neither zero a tenant's committed cost nor re-open reserve/settle replay. Keyed on the owner-signed org_id (a tenant can never be charged another tenant's cost). A weakened verify/clamp/idempotency/pairing guard lets a forged record charge a tenant, a settle over-report draw past the reserved envelope, or a pruned reserve vanish from the pool draw. DEFAULT-OFF primitive (not yet wired into the live launch-gate money path / EC-5 pool meter / keyless actual-token delivery). Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense), so not on the vigil_core-scoped kill-suite; per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_cost_ledger.py + test_snapshot_fold_cost_ledger.py.

EC-5 GLOBAL (cross-tenant) cost-pool meter + graduated kill-switch over the EC-4 cost ledger. A READ-ONLY fold (CostEnvelopeLedger.global_position -- one O(spine) pass, Sigma committed-settled + Sigma in-flight-reserved across ALL tenants, preserving the fold's verify_signed + SnapshotState-seeded seen-set so a forged/unsigned/negative cost record is inert in the global draw too). THREE load-bearing directions, each a mutation guard: (1) DEFAULT-OFF BYTE-IDENTICAL -- budget None/0 (config.global_pool_tokens unset) => UNBOUNDED => posture()/admit()/gate_refusal() short-circuit to NORMAL/full-admit/None BEFORE any ledger fold (an unset pool is zero-cost and the launch gate is byte-identical to pre-EC-5); (2) FAIL-CLOSED SAFE DIRECTION -- an ARMED pool whose meter raises postures REFUSE_NEW (never NORMAL), the access-reducing direction; (3) MONOTONE GRADUATION -- NORMAL<THROTTLE<DEGRADE<REFUSE_NEW<HARD_STOP on >= band fractions, admit() non-increasing in the used-fraction, the DEGRADE envelope floored >=1 and never > request. The launch gate composes it as ONE fail-closed conjunct (REFUSE_NEW/HARD_STOP refuse a NEW launch -- reversible: in-flight launches still settle and free the pool, so no owner-signed un-latch / release-replay surface; THROTTLE/DEGRADE do not refuse at the gate) and writes the EC-4 gate-writes-the-pair cost RESERVE/SETTLE (units*ENVELOPE_TOKENS_PER_CREDIT) gated default-OFF behind config.cost_ledger_write_enabled(), fail-safe (advisory metering: a cost-write error never breaks a real launch/settle), idempotent per (slug,nonce) via the shared reserve-cost:/settle-cost: prefixes, settle CLAMPED to the reserved envelope, all args from the VERIFIED lease. A weakened default-off/fail-closed/monotone/forged-inert guard lets an unset pool fold (cost), an unmeasurable armed pool admit new draw (over-spend), or a forged record move the global pool. Money anchor: the pool threshold is an OWNER number (reviewed-code placeholder + env, never a wire value); E single-sourced in vigil_core. Folds NO new signed record (snapshot stays v9), adds no prune tripwire. Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense; imports only cost_ledger + config + the vigil_core envelope constant), so not on the vigil_core-scoped kill-suite; per-slice mutation-verify ritual (7/7 guards killed, incl. the config band upper-bound h<=1.0 that stops a percent-vs-fraction typo silently disarming the armed kill-switch) + apps/sigil/tests/test_cost_pool.py.

EC-1b L2 deterministic LLM-response cache (the biggest AI-cost lever): serves a DETERMINISTIC completion (samples==1, temperature==0.0, older/non-current-gen model) from a per-tenant local store instead of re-calling the provider, at zero tokens. SECURITY-relevant invariant = cross-tenant/cross-engagement isolation: the store is PHYSICALLY sharded under paths.cache_l2_db() = _tenant_shard(v2_root()/'.cache/l2')/store.sqlite (a tenant-A process can only resolve its own shard, same mechanism as .memory/.blackboard), AND org_id (tenant_id()) + the engagement slug are in the sha256 key (logical defense-in-depth), so a cached answer never crosses tenants or engagements. Correctness invariants: the key is a PURE function (no wallclock/rng; created_at is TTL-only, never keyed), a HIT re-parses the stored raw against the LIVE prompt.schema (a value that no longer reproduces is a MISS, never a wrong answer), and the determinism gate EXCLUDES current-gen models (drop temperature for effort, not determinism-guaranteed) + samples>1 self-consistency. FAIL-SAFE: any store/lookup error degrades to a MISS/no-op, never into a completion; OFF (byte-identical) for a non-deterministic/dry-run/ZDR-ephemeral call or when CRUCIBLE_CACHE_DISABLE is set. A cached completion stays ADVISORY (the LLM advises, an oracle confirms — L2 never feeds the oracle/FACT path). Engine-plane; covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual (7/7 guards killed: determinism-gate current-model + nondeterministic exclusions, org_id + engagement in the key, TTL expiry, re-parse-against-live-schema, and the complete_with_backend hit-skips-provider wiring) + framework/v2/kernel/tests/test_ec1b_response_cache.py. Not on the vigil_core-scoped scheduled kill-suite (same rationale as the sovereign-leg money files).

EC-2a model-tier routing policy (the engine's biggest model-COST lever): lets an operator route the mechanical / no-oracle cognitive bindings to a cheaper model while the finding-critical ones stay capable. SOUNDNESS is untouched (a FACT is oracle-decided, never LLM-decided; routing touches no oracle) — only recall/precision of leads can move, which the benchmark eval gate measures (the A/B no-regression proof is EC-2b). Two SAFETY invariants are structural: (1) DEFAULT-OFF — routing_enabled() is False unless CRUCIBLE_MODEL_ROUTING is truthy, so resolve_model returns the backend's own configured model for every tier and the engine is byte-identical to pre-EC-2a (make gate byte-identical confirmed); (2) FAIL-TOWARD-CAPABLE — routing disabled, an empty/unknown tier name, or a recognised-but-UNMAPPED tier all resolve to the backend's capable default model; a cheaper model is returned ONLY where the operator explicitly mapped a recognised tier via CRUCIBLE_MODEL_TIER_<TIER>, so nothing ever silently downgrades. The per-binding default-tier table assigns the finding-GATE (self-critique), the lead GENERATOR (hypothesis-driven), and the severity DECISION (decision-frameworks) to the capable 'deep' tier; an unknown binding also falls back to 'deep'; NO binding defaults to 'cheap'. llm.resolve_effective_model is the ONE source of truth both a backend's complete() and the L2 cache seam resolve through, so the cache keys on — and the determinism gate sees — the exact model the provider was asked for (a tier routing to a current-gen model stays non-cacheable; an older-model tier is cacheable). FATAL-2: engine-plane, PURE (stdlib + env only), imports nothing from kernel.llm or the sovereign plane. A weakened default-OFF / fail-toward-capable / finding-critical=deep / L2-effective-key guard lets routing silently downgrade a finding-critical call or mis-key the cache. Engine-plane; covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual (5/5 guards killed: routing-enabled default, fail-toward-capable on unmapped, the critique/hypothesize/decide deep assignment, the L2 effective-model key, and binding.run's identity-tier assignment) + framework/v2/kernel/tests/test_routing.py. Not on the vigil_core-scoped scheduled kill-suite (same rationale as the sovereign-leg money files + response_cache.py).
